race.title: Mount Vines Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MILLE ET UNE VIES was Grade 3-placed in France and, while slightly disappointing at Cheltenham in March after 10 months off, this is a much softer assignment and she is likely to prove hard to beat, with Aeropress feared most after a promising hurdles debut at Worcester and Perfect Package a newcomer to note from an in-form yard. MILLE ET UNE VIES (FR) AEROPRESS (IRE) PERFECT PACKAGE (FR)
